name: @penguinharness/skill-porting
description: Port from external ecosystems after reviewing every file: skills into this agent's agent_state/skills/ (Claude Code plugin marketplaces, the Codex plugin repo, skills.sh registry names, GitHub repos, local folders), a whole plugin (a Codex or Claude Code plugin, a skills repository, a folder in a GitHub repository) into a PenguinHarness plugin package installed on the server with penguin plugin install, or a whole agent (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, Qoder, Qwen Code, WorkBuddy, Pi) into a new PenguinHarness agent created with penguin agent import.

penguin.description_zh: 审阅每个文件后从外部生态移植：把 Skill 装进本 Agent 的 agent_state/skills/（Claude Code 插件市场、Codex 插件仓库、skills.sh 注册名、GitHub 仓库、本地文件夹），把整个插件（Codex 或 Claude Code 插件、Skill 仓库、GitHub 仓库中的文件夹）转成 PenguinHarness 插件包，用 penguin plugin install 装到服务端，或把整个 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、DeepSeek Harness、Qoder、Qwen Code、WorkBuddy、Pi）迁移成新的 PenguinHarness Agent，用 penguin agent import 创建。
penguin.short_description: Port external skills, plugins and whole agents into PenguinHarness.
penguin.short_description_zh: 把外部的 Skill、插件和整个 Agent 移植进 PenguinHarness。

quick_start.prompt: Show me the skills available in the Claude Code plugin marketplace and recommend two that would suit this agent. Do not install anything yet.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 列出 Claude Code 插件市场里可移植的技能，推荐两个适合这个 Agent 的。先不要安装任何东西。

penguin.title: External Plugin Porting
